item.title: Agua Caliente Casinos Go Green for Month-Long St. Patrick’s Celebration
item.description: St. Patrick’s Day celebrations are already underway at Agua Caliente Casinos with a month-long “Lucky Cantina” experience at the Agave Tequila Bar.The festive décor sets the tone for a celebration packed with themed food and drinks.
